description: SyncRange lets you ask ChatGPT about the ecommerce, subscriptions, shipping, and advertising accounts you already connect in SyncRange. After you authorize read access, ChatGPT can list your connected accounts and return bucketed summaries for sales, orders, inventory, subscriptions, shipments, and ad performance across Shopify, Amazon Seller, Etsy, BigCommerce, Faire, ShipStation, Seal Subscriptions, Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Ads, Business Profile, Meta, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn, and Microsoft Bing Ads. Access is read-only, scoped to the sources you choose, and can be revoked anytime from SyncRange.

defaultPrompt: What accounts do I have connected?
How were Shopify sales last month, and which products sold best?
Summarize my Meta and Google Ads performance for the last 7 days, including spend and clicks.
